NAME
  sprint documents remove — Project/sprint documents; list excludes content, get includes content and current-owner subscription CAS metadata. documents list --include-deleted includes authorized deleted summaries and their current revisions for restore; default get remains 404 for deleted documents. Title 500/content 20000 UTF-16 units; CRLF/TAB retained. Delete retains history; restore requires current revision.

SYNOPSIS

DESCRIPTION
  Project/sprint documents; list excludes content, get includes content and current-owner subscription CAS metadata. documents list --include-deleted includes authorized deleted summaries and their current revisions for restore; default get remains 404 for deleted documents. Title 500/content 20000 UTF-16 units; CRLF/TAB retained. Delete retains history; restore requires current revision.

EXAMPLES
  sprint documents remove ID --expected-revision REVISION

POSITIONAL ARGUMENTS
  ID

FLAGS
  --expected-revision REVISION (required for existing resource) (required; see SYNOPSIS)

  --help, -h                 Show command help without authentication or network.
